newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel demands end to violence before summit.
newsitem.headline: Israel demands end to violence before summit.

text.p: Israel demands an end to violence before Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, an aide to the Israeli leader said on Sunday.
"The end to violence must come first of all," adviser David Bar-Illan told Israel Radio. "It's not a matter of a condition. It's a matter of an immediate development."
Bar-Illan said Netanyahu had asked Arafat for a meeting last Thursday. They spoke by telephone when the violence that has claimed nearly 70 lives was at a peak.
"He asked mainly to meet him so that he would immediately declare an end to the violence...Because it hasn't been completely done there is no point in any meeting."
